description: For questions like "how many people do I need" or "how many FTE does this workload take": cases, tickets, claims, orders or any work measured as volume times handling time. Applies shrinkage and target occupancy together; leaving out occupancy understates the people needed by about 15% at the 85% default. Give weekly volume and minutes per case; shrinkage, target occupancy and hours per week fall back to stated defaults. Returns FTE, people to staff (rounded up), every input marked given or assumed, and the arithmetic with numbers filled in. For volume that changes over time or any question about when to hire, see hiring_plan; for live queues with an answer-time target, see erlang_staffing.

hours_per_fte_week.description: Paid hours per full-time person per week. Default 40.

minutes_per_case.description: Average handling time per case, in minutes.

shrinkage.description: Share of paid time not available for the work: PTO, sick time, training, meetings. 0.30 means 30%. Default 0.3.

target_occupancy.description: Share of available time you plan to keep people busy with the work. Default 0.85.

weekly_volume.description: Cases, tickets or items arriving per week.

name: required_fte
title: FTE needed for a workload
